title: Act-LLM: A whole-process chain for character-centric role-playing with large language models
abstract_summary: Act-LLM combines character data construction, parameter-efficient tuning, preference optimization and long/short memory; it explicitly targets knowledge boundaries.
verification_notes: Publisher identifies 2026-01-15 volume date; SSRN preprint posted 2025-04-25. SSRN claims a 33-page legal author version, but direct access returned HTTP 403 in this environment; download status must reflect actual verification, not the abstract.

title: PsyMem: Fine-grained Psychological Alignment and Explicit Memory Control for Advanced Role-Playing LLMs
abstract_summary: PsyMem combines 26 psychological indicators with explicit training for memory-aligned role responses.
verification_notes: arXiv v1 appeared in 2025; TACL PDF states published 4/2026; year for filing is 2025.

title: ChatAnime: Towards User-Centered Emotional Support in LLM-based Virtual Character Chat
abstract_summary: ChatAnime evaluates emotional support and character portrayal on everyday scenarios, with human anime-fan responses.
verification_notes: Same ChatAnime dataset and experimental scale in 2025 preprint under changed title; ACL adds author Wenchang Gao and expands Xiao Pu name. Merge as one paper; first-public year 2025.

title: Too Good to be Bad: On the Failure of LLMs to Role-Play Villains
abstract_summary: Moral RolePlay shows declining fidelity for less prosocial fictional roles and weak transfer from general chatbot quality.
verification_notes: Extra paper; arXiv v1 in 2025, ACL in 2026; arXiv early author list ends with Linus, formal ACL list ends with Liefeng Bo.

title: Deriving Character Logic from Storyline as Codified Decision Trees
abstract_summary: Induces validated executable scene-condition/action decision trees from storylines; tests character behavior grounding.
verification_notes: arXiv v1 predates ACL publication.

title: Role-Playing Agents Driven by Large Language Models: Current Status, Challenges, and Future Trends
abstract_summary: Survey of role-playing agents, from style imitation to psychological modeling, memory, decisions and evaluation.
verification_notes: Review article; use reference list for backward chaining, not as primary effectiveness evidence.

title: AdaMARP: An Adaptive Multi-Agent Interaction Framework for General Immersive Role-Playing
abstract_summary: AdaMARP interleaves thought, action, environment and speech; a scene manager makes explicit scene and cast decisions.
verification_notes: Extra paper from action/scene expansion; arXiv v1 predates ACL.

title: HER: Human-like Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning for LLM Role-playing
abstract_summary: HER trains first-person character thinking separately from third-person model reasoning, using supervised data and role-play rewards.
verification_notes: arXiv v1 predates ACL; ACL abstract and title are authoritative for formal version.

title: Codified Finite-state Machines for Role-playing
abstract_summary: Codified finite-state machines turn profile statements into executable state transitions, with probabilistic variants for uncertain actions.
verification_notes: Extra paper from CDT reference/author trail; ICLR paper includes real narrative role-play cases. ICLR proceedings gives year only.

title: PERSONA: Dynamic and Compositional Inference-Time Personality Control via Activation Vector Algebra
abstract_summary: PERSONA extracts Big Five activation directions and composes them for context-dependent trait control.
verification_notes: ICLR formal page and arXiv agree on title/authors; trait steering does not prove full character recreation. ICLR proceedings gives year only.

title: Rethinking Role-Playing Evaluation: Anonymous Benchmarking and A Systematic Study of Personality Effects
abstract_summary: Anonymous character evaluation tests how much a familiar name cues role performance versus supplied personality evidence.
verification_notes: arXiv v1 predates SIGDIAL; publication month from ACL.

title: Memory-Driven Role-Playing: Evaluation and Enhancement of Persona Knowledge Utilization in LLMs
abstract_summary: MREval diagnoses persona-memory anchoring, selecting, bounding and enacting; MRPrompt guides memory use.
verification_notes: arXiv abstract names Recalling while ACL abstract names Selecting; record formal terminology and note version change.

title: StratMem-Bench: Evaluating Strategic Memory Use in Virtual Character Conversation Beyond Factual Recall
abstract_summary: Benchmarks choosing required, supportive and irrelevant memories in character conversation, beyond factual recall.
verification_notes: arXiv v1 predates ACL publication.

title: BOOKMARKS: Efficient Active Storyline Memory for Role-playing
abstract_summary: BOOKMARKS maintains storyline-point questions whose answers are synchronized as the story advances to ground character acting.
verification_notes: Extra paper from backward/forward expansion; arXiv v1 2026-05-13.

title: PersonaArena: Dynamic Simulation for Evaluating and Enhancing Persona-Level Role-Playing in Large Language Models
abstract_summary: PersonaArena simulates multi-turn everyday social interactions and debates evaluations across persona profiles.
verification_notes: Extra paper; studies broad social personas rather than fidelity to an established fictional canon.

title: DREAM: LLM-based Dynamic Role-playing via Event-Aware Memory Graph
venue: arXiv preprint; KDD 2026 accepted per authors
abstract_summary: DREAM uses an event-aware memory graph and a temporal-causal benchmark for evolving character behavior.
verification_notes: The official arXiv page lists v1 as 2026-05-27 despite a 2608 identifier; preserve page date and flag the inconsistency. KDD acceptance is stated on arXiv; proceedings date not verified.

title: RoleCDE: Benchmarking and Mitigating Role-Alignment Trade-offs in Role-Playing Agents
abstract_summary: RoleCDE probes value conflicts between character motives and assistant alignment in structured dilemmas.
verification_notes: arXiv abstract and formal ACL PDF report about 24k instances (the PDF specifies 23,871); ACL landing-page abstract incorrectly says nearly 240k. Prefer the formal PDF, which ACL explicitly treats as authoritative for corrections.

title: Staying In Character: Perspective-Bounded Memory For Book-Based Role-Playing Agents
abstract_summary: REVERIEMEM separates first-person episodic scenes, visibility-tagged facts and situational speech patterns; KBF-QA tests knowledge perspective.
verification_notes: Original arXiv v1 date 2026-06-24. This tests knowledge visibility, not skill limits.

title: Beyond Static Persona Consistency: Dynamic Persona Coherence in LLM Role-Playing
abstract_summary: Separates stable identity from changing psychological state and evaluates multi-turn adaptation and drift.
verification_notes: ACL gives month only; no verified earlier release found.

title: ThinkPersona: Thinking with Persona Graphs for Faithful Individualized Role-Playing
abstract_summary: Uses persona graphs of life events, values and relationships plus question-reasoning-answer fine-tuning for individualized role-play.
verification_notes: ACL gives month only; no verified earlier release found. Real-person interview personas are a transfer case, not fictional canon.

title: PersonaForge: Psychology-Grounded Dual-Process Architecture for Personality-Consistent Role-Playing Agents
abstract_summary: PersonaForge uses layered traits, defense mechanisms and selective inner monologue to address multi-turn personality drift.
verification_notes: Extra paper; ACL gives month only and no verified preprint. Distinct from unrelated arXiv 2608.28378 also named PersonaForge.

title: Understanding Generalization in Role-Playing Models via Information Theory
abstract_summary: Information-theoretic diagnostic measures role model degradation under user, character and dialogue shifts.
verification_notes: Extra paper; ACL gives month only and no verified preprint.

title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
venue: arXiv preprint; Social Sim 26 workshop per authors
abstract_summary: Role-specific activation directions are screened per simulated role; 38 roles decline on all measured dimensions.
verification_notes: The official arXiv page lists v1 as 2026-07-09 despite a 2608 identifier. Measures role-profile alignment, not complete fictional-character fidelity.

title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
abstract_summary: PALATE lets per-user simulators hold free-form multi-turn conversations with role agents and compares personalized rubrics with human judgments.
verification_notes: Extra paper; user-experience evaluation complements, but does not establish fictional-canon fidelity.

title: CHARM: Character Hallucination for Multicultural Role Play Benchmark
venue: arXiv preprint; accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026 per authors
abstract_summary: CHARM tests 40 real and fictional characters across five cultural-linguistic regions, separating recognition of temporal/cross-universe knowledge limits from compliance when answering.
verification_notes: arXiv v1 2026-09-01 is within the 2026-09-25 cutoff; arXiv PDF is openly accessible. Findings of EMNLP acceptance is stated on arXiv, but no formal proceedings date or ID was verified. This studies knowledge boundaries, not skill or social ability ceilings.
